title: Progressive Panel Tabs and Remembered Fold State
description: Make corner-panel tab trees progressive: pressing a branch tab reveals only its immediate-children row (no auto-descend to first leaf); panel body stays empty until a leaf is picked. Re-pressing an expanded branch collapses that level and clears remembered drill-down below it; re-pressing the root corner tab when only its children are shown folds the panel. Each branch remembers the last child drilled into so returning restores the previous drill-down (validated against the current tree). Persist across reloads: corner panel visible/size/path, per-branch path memory, and tree section/group expansion — via a new layered os/app localStorage store (DockUiStateStore, cloned from DockLayoutStore), diff-only, cleared by the existing Reset panels action. Core changes: reconcileActivePath becomes truncate-only (no first-sibling substitution, no auto-descend); PanelTabBar row reveal becomes path-driven; new progressPanelTabSelection pure helper implements collapse/root-reset/fold/memory-extend semantics; Tree/TreeStateProvider gain controlled openStates (Tree owns its own internal provider that shadows the per-unit one, so control must go through Tree itself, namespaced per PanelTreeUnit); os-shell.tsx reducer gains panelPathMemory/treeOpenStates, studio/details tab overrides move from read-time reassertion to a write-through effect (so user collapse sticks), setActivePanelTab dispatches get a leaf-only guard. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis.md.
summary:
Made corner-panel tab trees progressive and persisted all fold/drill-down/expansion state across reloads.

**Progressive reveal** (`ui/js/react/index.tsx`):
- `reconcileActivePath` changed from "fall back to first sibling + auto-descend to a leaf" to plain validate-and-truncate: walk the path, stop at the first segment no longer present at its level, no substitution, no descent. `[]` is a valid result.
- Removed the two remaining first-sibling highlight fallbacks that depended on the old semantics: `PanelTabRow`'s `resolvedActiveId` and `PanelTabBar`'s row-loop `activeId`.
- `PanelTabBar`'s row loop is now purely path-driven: row *k+1* renders only when `activePath[k]` names a branch at row *k*; `onSelect` emits the raw spliced path with no reconcile, leaving interpretation to the host.
- New pure helper `progressPanelTabSelection(tabs, currentPath, selectedPath, memory)` implements the actual UX rules: fresh picks reveal one level and extend from remembered drill-down (pruning stale entries); re-pressing an active branch collapses it (clearing its subtree's memory but keeping the parent's own hop); re-pressing the root resets to immediate children first, then folds on a second press; deselecting a nested active leaf no longer folds the panel (only a depth-0 press does).
- `CornerPanel`/`MobilePanel` rewired on this helper; folded panels now unfold-and-keep their stored path instead of re-running collapse/reset semantics.

**Tree expansion persistence**: `Tree`/`TreeStateProvider` gained optional controlled `openStates`/`onOpenStateChange` (uncontrolled `useState` fallback otherwise). Discovered `Tree` mounts its *own* internal `TreeStateProvider` that shadows `PanelTreeUnitsPane`'s old per-unit wrapper — that outer provider was dead weight for expansion state and was removed; control now flows through `Tree` itself, namespaced per unit (`${unitId}:${innerId}`) so keys never collide across a leaf tab's units.

**`DockUiStateStore`** (`framework/core/js/index.ts`): cloned the `DockLayoutStore` pattern — layered os/app localStorage (`semio.os.dockUi` / `semio.os.dockUi.${appId}`, deliberately distinct from `DockLayoutStore`'s `semio.os.dock.${appId}` to avoid colliding with an app literally named "ui"), diff-only (`save(null)` removes the key), `reset()` clears both layers, defensive JSON parsing. Persists per-corner `visible`/`size`/`path` (each field omitted when equal to its default), drill-down `pathMemory`, and `treeOpen`.

**Shell wiring** (`framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx`): reducer gained `panelPathMemory`/`treeOpenStates` + `SET_PANEL_PATH_MEMORY`/`SET_TREE_OPEN_STATE`/`HYDRATE_DOCK_UI` actions; `RESET_DOCK` now also resets visibility/size/memory/expansion (previously left fold/size untouched — a deliberate behavior change since those are now persisted state, not just session state); studio/details "snap to the active panel tab" overrides converted from read-time reassertion (which would have instantly undone a user's collapse under progressive reveal) to a write-through effect that only dispatches when the override's target tab id actually changes, with studio winning over details when both target the same corner; `setActivePanelTab` dispatches now guard on the resolved node actually being a leaf, since progressive paths routinely end at a branch or are empty.

**Bug fixed during implementation**: a name collision with a concurrent developer's unrelated `collectPanelTabSubtreeIds(node, into: Set)` helper (different arity/signature) was caught by a build error and resolved by renaming mine to `panelTabSubtreeIds`; one stray call site inside `progressPanelTabSelection` still referenced the old shared name after the rename (missed by the initial exact-string replace) and threw at runtime — caught by my own new test suite and fixed before it could reach anyone else.

Tests: updated 4 pre-existing tests that encoded the old auto-descend/fold-only-on-full-repress behavior, plus the `framework/renderer/react` RESET_DOCK test (now asserts full reset). Added 12 new tests: 7 for `DockUiStateStore` (mirroring `DockLayoutStore`'s suite, plus a dedicated key-collision-avoidance test), and 5 in `ui/js/react/index.tsx` covering `progressPanelTabSelection`'s full rule set, `CornerPanel` unfold-keeps-path/nested-leaf-deselect, controlled `pathMemory`, `Tree`'s controlled open-state surviving remount, and `PanelTreeUnitsPane`'s per-unit namespacing.

Verified: all three suites (`ui-react`, `framework-core`, `framework-renderer-react`) pass, `ui-react` at the same stable 14 pre-existing/unrelated failures as every prior check this session. Live in `note-react-dev`: pressing a corner tab reveals only its immediate children with an empty body; drilling to a leaf shows content and records `semio.os.dockUi.note-play` with exactly the diff (`visible`, `path`, `pathMemory` — no untouched corners, no default-valued fields); re-pressing the root while deep resets to immediate children and clears memory; re-pressing again folds the panel (path kept in storage, `visible` correctly omitted once back to default `false`... then re-added once re-opened); unfolding a folded panel restores the kept path without re-running collapse logic; a full page reload restored the exact persisted visible/path state.
